bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, residents protested on the Chennai Tirupati highway after a five-hour unannounced power cut, and the office should monitor power supply stability.
The personal assistant to the Thiruvallur collector was booked under the POCSO act for harassment, and the office should monitor the legal proceedings.
Allegations of large-scale gravel sand mining corruption have emerged in Gummidipoondi, and the office should watch for environmental department updates.
A lorry carrying liquor bottles worth 56 lakh rupees overturned near Avadi, causing a traffic stir, and the office should track road safety measures.
Police arrested a thief in Thiruvallur who stole 21 batteries from four locations using CCTV footage, and the office should commend local law enforcement.
Chennai Mayor Priya will take legal action over a circulated AI-generated video, and the office should monitor deepfake regulations and misuse.
A new modern MRI scan center with AI technology was launched at MGM Healthcare Malar Hospital, and the office should watch digital health sector growth.
A JP Morgan report stated AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs globally in five years, and the office should review labor market impacts.
Mayor Priya accused TVK members of circulating an AI-generated vulgar video targeting her, and the office should monitor political tensions and cyber complaints.
Mayor Priya criticized the government and stated funds were denied to GCC, and the office should watch municipal funding developments.
